allowed_public_claims: Relaytic-AML can convert a rowless external detector-score artifact into evidence cells with schema, hash, leakage-posture, and claim-state metadata.
Relaytic-AML can produce a rowless handoff summary for hosted detector-output governance.

interpretation: This case study shows that Relaytic-AML can host a rowless detector-score artifact as governed evidence: the adapter records schema and content hashes, creates evidence cells, redacts unsafe handoff fields, and blocks stronger detector or production claims. It is not a detector-performance result.

relaytic_checks.requirement: external score-file adapter route is selected
score artifact has required schema, metadata, rowless posture, and bounded claim state
at least one evidence cell is emitted
claim gate allows only hosted-detector-output governance wording
handoff redacts rows, identifiers, private paths, raw scores, and secrets
score artifact or deterministic fixture is available
score artifact parses as JSON object
artifact carries dataset, split, schema, metric, leakage, and claim-state metadata
artifact does not expose raw rows, identifiers, local paths, secrets, or raw score payloads
claim state is hosted detector-output governance only
P19-A does not promote detector-performance metrics
